expected_bands.label: Water
expected_bands.biosignature_relevance: Indicates volatiles and is required for surface liquid water, but water vapour is abundant in hot gas giants and is not itself a biosignature.

expected_bands.label: Carbon dioxide
expected_bands.biosignature_relevance: Confirms an atmosphere exists and constrains its mean molecular weight. Abiotic and abundant on Venus and Mars.

expected_bands.label: Methane
expected_bands.biosignature_relevance: Biologically produced on Earth, but also outgassed abiotically by serpentinisation and volcanism. Interesting mainly in DISEQUILIBRIUM with O2, not on its own.

expected_bands.label: Carbon monoxide
expected_bands.biosignature_relevance: Generally an anti-biosignature: abundant CO alongside O2 suggests photochemical rather than biological oxygen production.

expected_bands.label: Sulphur dioxide
expected_bands.biosignature_relevance: Volcanic and photochemical. Its JWST detection in WASP-39 b is evidence of photochemistry, not of biology.

caveat: Eclipse depth is the wavelength-dependent planet/star flux ratio. Expected band positions are context, not molecular detections; interpretation belongs to the cited analyses.
